# H029 — Genes whose surviving-k-mer bait density is below half the median yield no confident k-mer genotype.

## The claim

Genes whose surviving-k-mer bait density is below half the median yield no confident k-mer genotype.

**Prediction if true.** Every allele in a gene flagged unreachable by the stage-0 reachability rule returns a no-call, or a posterior below 0.95, or fewer than three usable probe pairs.

**What would refute it.** A gene below half the median bait density yields a confident genotype at posterior >= 0.95 with three agreeing probes, in which case the reachability limit is weaker than claimed and the rule is reported as conservative.

## Weighing

```
prior 0.50  (log-odds +0.000)
  -1.600  refutes 0.80 — The 21 genes the stage-0 reachability rule excluded yield 215 confident calls across 1,222 alleles, a 17.6% rate rather than none.   -> 0.168
  +1.000  supports 0.50 — Reachable genes yield a confident call for 59.6% of their alleles, so the gate is 3.4 times enriched for callable alleles even though it is not absolute.   -> 0.354
suggested confidence 0.35 (1 supporting, 1 refuting, 0 neutral)
```

The weighing is a transparent heuristic for triage, not a calibrated posterior: the strengths are human judgments, and rows drawn from the same underlying data are not independent the way the sum treats them.

**The committed confidence differs from the suggestion by -0.15.** The reasoning below is why.

| 2 | refuted | 0.20 | The claim said an excluded gene yields no confident genotype. The 21 excluded genes yield 215 confident calls across 1,222 alleles. Refuted. The rule is not useless — reachable genes call at 59.6% against 17.6%, a 3.4-fold enrichment — so it is reported as conservative rather than dropped, and an absence in an excluded gene is still not a finding. Confidence above H024's because the refutation is clean and the measured enrichment gives the rule a defensible, quantified role. |
